details.description: RolmOCR is an open-source optical character recognition model published by Reducto AI, built by fine-tuning Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct on the full allenai/olmOCR-mix-0225 dataset. Reducto AI describes it as a faster, lighter, drop-in alternative to the Allen Institute for AI's olmOCR that uses less memory while still performing well across a variety of document types, and releases it under the Apache 2.0 license. Compared with the original olmOCR approach, RolmOCR drops PDF-derived metadata from its input (reducing prompt length, processing time, and VRAM usage) and rotates about 15% of its training data to improve robustness on off-angle document images.
advantages: Reducto AI reports it is faster and uses less memory than olmOCR, the tool it was designed to replace, while still performing well on a variety of document types, per the model card.
Drops PDF-derived metadata from the input prompt, which Reducto AI says lowers processing time and VRAM usage without hurting accuracy in most cases, per the model card.
About 15% of its training data was rotated during fine-tuning to improve robustness to off-angle (rotated) document images, per the model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, per the model card.
disadvantages: Like other VLM-based OCR models, it can hallucinate or drop content, per the model card's Limitations section.
Cannot output layout bounding boxes, unlike Reducto AI's commercial Parsing API, per the model card.
Reducto AI states it has not evaluated the performance of quantized versions of the model, per the model card.
use_cases: Extracting plain text from scanned documents and images, including off-angle pages
Drop-in replacement for olmOCR-based document OCR pipelines

notes: The catalog's modality facts for this target list only text_input/text_output, but Reducto AI's model card describes RolmOCR as an image-text-to-text vision-language model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct that takes document images as input -- that is the model's entire purpose. Kept the catalog's modality as authoritative per instructions and flag the discrepancy here rather than restating a different modality in the details. No numeric accuracy/benchmark figures were found on the model card, so evaluations is left empty. No deprecation or legacy notice was found; the model card was last modified 2025-04-02.
